info.title: Organization API
info.description: Organization API allows you to manage the personal data of an Organization.

technical_account_manager.description: Technical account manager attached to the Organization.

values.no_longer_needed: I no longer need Scaleway's products
values.missing_feature: I need some features you don't have

values.difficult_to_use: I find it difficult to use

created_at.description: Creation date of the Organization. (RFC 3339 format)

updated_at.description: Last modification date of the Organization. (RFC 3339 format)

type.description: Type of this Organization (personal or professional).

currency.description: Currency defined in the signed Terms of Service.

warnings.description: All warnings attached to this Organization.

billing_email.description: Email on which invoices are sent Email to which invoices are sent. If empty, the Owner's email is used. Replaced by the Notification manager.

mfa_enforced.description: Set to true if MFA is required for the Organization.

dedibox_account.description: Contains ID and link creation date if a dedibox account is linked.

is_startup.description: Deprecated. Set to true if the Organization is identified as a startup.

badges.description: All badges attached to this Organization.

tax_code.description: Tax code for if required for your country.

certified_email_address.description: Certified email address if required for your country.

recipient_code.description: Recipient Code if required for your country (e.g SDI, PPF).

company_registration_number.description: The primary identification number for the legal entity.

establishment_registration_number.description: The identification number for a specific branch, operating unit, or physical location of the company.

id.description: ID of the support plan. (UUID format)

started_at.description: Creation date of the support plan. (RFC 3339 format)

stopped_at.description: End date of the support plan. (RFC 3339 format)

srn.description: The SRN of the support plan.

get.summary: Get the Organization with the given ID
Get the active support plan for the Organization Get the support plan for the Organization along with the Technical Account Manager contact information.

parameters.description: Number of items per page. Value must be between 1 and 1000.
